details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:640-649 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The PR adds the "Stuck states P4 (Refs #8291)" comment block and the E2E_PHASE4B_QUEUED_GRACE_ENABLED / E2E_RETRY_QUEUED_GRACE_MINUTES env entries at lines 640-649, plus comment text at 2380-2382 and 2406. This brings the workflow to 430,394 bytes, over the 430,000-byte cap that tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_step_scripts_contract.py:32 (MAX_WORKFLOW_BYTES = 430_000) and :74-76 enforce.
  WHY: CI on head 9a2e7c4b fails with "AssertionError: 430394 / assert 430394 <= 430000" in tests-system-python (4) and tests-promote-stall-and-review, and the aggregate lint job then fails, so the PR cannot pass its required checks. All reviewers rate it BLOCKER. Reviewers agree on the fix: trim the 8-line comment at 640-647, which duplicates scripts/stable_e2e_step_verify_bait_removed.sh:441-452, and do not raise MAX_WORKFLOW_BYTES.
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:(lint job, step "Run set -euo pipefail") | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The lint job fails structurally when it reads the CI job results (CI_NEEDS_JSON).
  WHY: The reviewer says CI validation cannot parse the job-result JSON, which blocks PR status checks. minimax_minimax-m3 disputes this: the log shows the aggregate gate failing on the two upstream job failures, which is the size-cap root cause.
- tests/promote-stall-and-review:(job execution) | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The integration suite fails with multiple SEMBLE_FALLBACK and unexpected test failures.
  WHY: The promotion-cycle logic changes cannot be verified, which blocks PR validation and release-gate progression.
- scripts/review_autofix_sweep_reaper.sh:59 (also .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml:307, 576) | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The reaper enable switch uses deny-list logic: only false|0|no|off turn it off, so any other value, such as a typo or "disabled", enables it.
  WHY: An unexpected value triggers up to 20 cancel/force-cancel POSTs per sweep using the actions: write token, which contradicts the documented opt-in contract. The fix is an allow-list (1|true|yes|on) in all three places.
- scripts/review_autofix_sweep_reaper.sh:review_autofix_sweep_reap_zombie_runs | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The reaper is an implicit-execution surface that modifies workflow run state.
  WHY: Unintended cancellations are a risk. Earlier testing hit 409 errors on wedged runs, and although the reaper defaults to off it can still run if the repo variable is misconfigured.
- .github/workflows/plan.yml, .github/workflows/orchestrate_clarify_respond.yml:("Stage workflow support files" unified branch, support_bundle_dir read-back) | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: If the SUPPORT_SCRIPTS_DIR read-back is empty or not a directory, the filter does nothing: every listed name goes into scripts/.gitignore and nothing is logged. implement.yml fails closed in the same case.
  WHY: The path cannot be reached under the current stager, which always writes SUPPORT_SCRIPTS_DIR. If it were reached, a consumer-owned scripts/<name> could be silently hidden from commits. This is a consistency gap.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: P4: "Move the retry body into `scripts/e2e_phase4b_retry.sh`." (docs/plans/remove-unattended-pipeline-stuck-states-plan.md:171, :281, :385)
  expected_change_site: new scripts/e2e_phase4b_retry.sh, sourced by the "Phase 4b: Verify editor restored canary (pytest + retry)" step of .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml (lines 2422-2443)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: scripts/e2e_phase4b_retry.sh does not exist in the checkout or in pr_changed_files.txt. The retry logic still lives in scripts/stable_e2e_step_verify_bait_removed.sh (lines 438-507 / 439-479). .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:2438-2443 still sets STABLE_E2E_STEP_SCRIPT to stable_e2e_step_verify_bait_removed.sh and sources it. The timing behaviour landed, but the named helper file did not, and minimax ties this to the size-cap failure.
- requirement: P13: "Project security pass line ownership and rebinding. Implements docs/plans/security-pass-convergence-plan.md Phase A and Phase B exactly as written" (SECURITY_PASS_REBOUND, SECURITY_PASS_VERIFIED_FIXED, verified_fixed_finding_ids, SECURITY_PASS_LINE_OWNERSHIP)
  expected_change_site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh (clean-pass head-advance path, ~9642-9665), scripts/security_audit.sh, scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: None of these identifiers appears in the PR diff. A repo-wide grep finds them only in docs/plans/security-pass-convergence-plan.md and docs/plans/remove-unattended-pipeline-stuck-states-plan.md, and no implementation or test exists. Several reviewers say P13 is deferred to separate PRs off main: sonnet does not count it as a defect, and google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash say it is not a gap. minimax says the PR title "P2a-P13 remainder" and plan Q5 should then say so.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:640-649 (also 2381-2382, 2406; cap at tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_step_scripts_contract.py:32, :74-76) | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The workflow is 430,394 bytes, 394 bytes over the 430,000 cap. Most of the added bytes are the 8-line comment at 640-647, which duplicates scripts/stable_e2e_step_verify_bait_removed.sh.
  WHY: CI on 9a2e7c4b fails "AssertionError: 430394 / assert 430394 <= 430000" in tests-promote-stall-and-review and tests-system-python shard 4, and the lint aggregate fails. Fix: cut 640-647 to one line, keep 648-649 and 2406, and do not raise MAX_WORKFLOW_BYTES.
- .github/workflows/plan.yml and .github/workflows/orchestrate_clarify_respond.yml:"Stage workflow support files" unified branch (support_bundle_dir read-back) | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: An empty or non-directory read-back makes the filter a no-op, so every name is added to scripts/.gitignore and nothing is logged. implement.yml fails closed in this case.
  WHY: The path cannot be reached today. If it were, a consumer-owned scripts/<name> could be hidden without warning. This is a consistency gap.
- scripts/review_autofix_sweep_reaper.sh:59 (also .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml lines 307, 576) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The deny-list enable switch means any value other than false/0/no/off enables the reaper.
  WHY: A typo or "disabled" triggers up to 20 cancel/force-cancel POSTs per sweep (run 43095142301 shows 409s). Fix: allow-list 1|true|yes|on (~6 lines).
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: P13, security pass line ownership and rebinding (SECURITY_PASS_REBOUND, verified_fixed_finding_ids, SECURITY_PASS_LINE_OWNERSHIP). | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  Expected change site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, scripts/security_audit.sh, scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh
  Evidence of absence: The identifiers are not in the PR diff. The plan and the editor summary defer P13 to separate PRs, so the reviewer does not report it as a defect.
- HARDENING (2 related items): review_autofix_sweep.yml ~line 304 has a misleading commented-out line with `${ZOMBIE_RUN_REAPER_ENABLED:-true}`; rewrite it as prose (1 line). Separately, apply the reaper allow-list switch (6 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2
